notes: REF-BM-08: selecting a list item (card media/title) navigates to the internal detail page, not the original url; the original is only reachable via an 'Open original' link on the detail page. REF-BM-14: tag search in the query uses `tag:name` syntax, not the specified `#tag` syntax (`#article` is treated as plain text). REF-BM-15: AND/OR, parentheses, and operator-quoting are implemented, but the NOT operator is absent from the lexer/parser. REF-BM-20: no multi-select or bulk-action UI/endpoints exist; only single-item operations. REF-BM-21: no bulk action over the filtered collection exists. REF-BM-24: no snapshot feature at all (no local HTML snapshot, no PDF download branch — non-HTML content types just return 'unsupported'). REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter entity, routes, or storage. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no export functionality. REF-BM-32: preferences support only default sort field/direction; no displayed-items count or font-size settings.
